root_cause: On main 01af9f2a, the canonical five-minute Required Gate Watchdog selected a real failing gate and attempted a same-owner PR issue comment, but GitHub returned HTTP 403 Resource not accessible by integration; the workflow declared issues:write and pull-requests:read. An uncaught denied POST terminated the entire tick, potentially preventing further missing-gate recovery.
impact: Canonical repair owners do not receive actionable failed-gate signals; subsequent PRs remain unexamined when one provider post is denied.
fix: Extend the SAME existing watchdog permission to pull-requests:write for PR comments, bound both failed and successful signal attempts to two per tick, catch denied owner signal individually, preserve missing-run dispatch and append immutable failure to the same job summary; exit red after processing if any delivery failed. Never record a denied post as completed.
prevention_rule: Check effective Actions token permission against exact endpoint and provider readback, not YAML issues-write alone; failed comment POST is undelivered, remain red, bound retries/attempts and carry immutable run + canonical PR owner to the existing registry and skill projection. Do not duplicate scheduler/writer or waive Required/CodeQL/CLS.

test_evidence.before: GitHub #39811993147 failed with 403 PR comment denial; no later owner delivery proved
